_notes: char_limit=500 is the Mastodon server default; individual instances may raise this limit. link_char_cost=23 follows the same convention as Twitter (URLs counted at 23 chars on most instances). max_image_size_bytes=10 MB. max_video_size_bytes=40 MB.
